Name: Growable Geode
Author: ChillsEmporium
Description:
About This Mod

This mod lets you grow all the games in the game like a normal crop and you can buy the seeds from Pierre
[line]Features
[list]
[*]✦ Lets you grow any geode
[*]✦ ﻿Works all year round
[*]✦  Needs water
[/list][line]Installation Instructions

[list]
[*]Download and Extract
After downloading the mod, extract the contents.[*]Move the Mod Folder
Place the folder named Growable Stone into:[code]Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods
[/code][*]Install Required Dependencies
This mod requires the following: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Modding ApI[/url]﻿[/list][line]Compatibility
[list]
[*]Should work with all mods
[/list][line]Requirements
[list]
[*]Game version 1.6
